audit_items.proof_trace: The denominator `debt + cash - cash_reserve` cannot underflow: a conservation invariant (maintained through borrow, deposit, accrue_interest, withdrawal, repay, and liquidation operations) guarantees `debt + cash >= cash_reserve` at all times, so the bare u256 subtraction in `float::sub` never aborts. While `util_rate > 1` is mathematically reachable (asymptotic limit is `1/(1-rf)` as interest accumulates), the current implementation uses `repay_fee_rate` as the reserve_factor—typically 1–100 basis points—requiring thousands of years of accumulated interest without any protocol interaction to breach the invariant; even with the maximum valid `repay_fee_rate = 10000 bp` (100%), no abort occurs since `calc_interest` extrapolates linearly for util_rate > 1 rather than panicking.
